13281.name: Jordyn Tyson

brief.prose: The plan for Moore and Nussmeier's offense was Tyson as a downfield weapon opposite Chris Olave, but an Aug. 13 hamstring strain (joint practice vs Jacksonville) has put real time on the shelf, with NFL Media pegging recovery at roughly two months and the team acknowledging he could open on IR (a minimum four-game absence). brief.rationale: Two-month hamstring with possible IR; a redraft fade who misses the opening month, worth only a bench stash for later upside.
